notes: Real River run: LoRA rank 16 on Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B, 20 steps x batch 16 (108 examples: 69 @viewfy_ai posts, 33 replies, 6 synthetic founder emails), lr 1e-4, cross_entropy on completion tokens only. Loss = River's summed CE metric / completion tokens (0.251 -> 0.153). voiceMatch 0.78 is a hand estimate after reading samples; the script's char-trigram voice score is 0.72 tuned vs 0.46 for the untuned base model (base writes 'I hope this email finds you well', emoji lists, [Your Name]). One RL demo step ran on top (importance_sampling, 8 rollouts, fake hourly outcomes, mean reward 0.49).
